notes.title: First Week Lookback + What’s to Come
notes.notes: [h1][b]First Week Lookback + What’s to Come[/b][/h1][p]Evolve Lab has now been out in early access for one week. It’s incredible to see that over a thousand of you have already created more than 30,000 creatures.[/p][p]I love seeing the different builds you are coming up with and I am excited to watch the meta take shape in the days ahead.[/p][p]It has also been amazing to see so many content creators cover Evolve Lab. If you haven’t watched them yet, I highly recommend searching for Evolve Lab on YouTube.[/p][p]It makes me really happy to see a small and dedicated community beginning to form :)[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Your feedback matters[/h2][p]I am constantly collecting your feedback and using it to guide the future of the game. If you have been enjoying Evolve Lab, it would mean a lot if you could take a moment to write a review. Reviews not only help me improve the game by showing what you like and what could be better, but they also help new players discover it and grow the community.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]Tentative Roadmap[/h1][p]I have put together a rough roadmap of what will be added and changed. The order and priority may shift depending on your feedback, but my plan is to release a new patch at least every two weeks.[/p][p]Here is what I am working on:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Extra Lives on all planets[/b][/h3][p]Many of you have asked for this, so I will be adding the option to choose one or two extra lives instead of multiple creatures on all current and future planets.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Faster Progression[/b][/h3][p]If players struggle to get a strong run early on, unlocking new content can take longer than intended. I will adjust the research points earned for reaching certain depths to make progression smoother.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Post-Combat Screen[/b][/h3][p]After each battle, you will be able to look at the creature you just fought. In later updates I also plan to add more detailed combat stats to this screen.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Skins and Hats[/b][/h3][p]I’m certain many of you have already collected quite a few pioneer tokens. Once this feature is ready, you will be able to use them to unlock skins and hats, which can then be added to your creatures by spending research or deep research points. These will not alter the gameplay in any way and only change how your creature looks.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Rotating Planets[/b][/h3][p]Rotating planets will be time-limited with a small selection of creatures and shop options, and possibly even special rules. They are designed to add more variety to the game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Planet 5 and unstable planets[/b][/h3][p]New planets are of course on the way. Each planet will come with 2 new creatures, 10 new actions, 4 new modules, and 12 new cores. Before all content for a planet is finished, I will occasionally release unstable versions where players can test some of the new content. Keep in mind that not everything shown there will necessarily be added permanently, and some elements may change significantly.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Better Depth Overview[/b][/h3][p]I want to redesign the depth overview and expand the information it shows so that you can see how many fights your creature is winning and other stats you might be interested in. I am also considering adding a leaderboard to the depth overview.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More Polish[/b][/h3][p]Mechanically the game is already in a good place, but presentation can always be improved. I plan to add new particle effects, sound effects, and enhancements to the UI and existing textures.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Performance and Networking Improvements[/b][/h3][p]The game runs smoothly for most players, but a small group has reported performance or connection issues. I will continue to work on fixes and optimizations to minimize these problems.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Please keep in mind that I am working on this project mostly alone, so it may take some time to implement all of these features.[/p][p]Once again, thank you all so much for playing, sharing your thoughts, and helping shape Evolve Lab into the best game it can be. Having all of you here is what motivates and fulfills me the most while working on the game :D[/p]

notes.title: Evolve Lab Is Available Now in Early Access!

[b]You can now play Evolve Lab Early Access[/b] with a 10% launch discount![/p][p][/p][h3]Content in the release:[/h3][p]The game now features 4 different planets which offer a ton of different options for you to play with. Here you can see all shop options that in the game right now:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39989439/261f3f6aeaabe3a4726fac5d6fcfff23dcc769f7.png"][/img][/p][p]I hope you will all have a blast playing and can't wait to see what builds you will all come up with![/p][p][/p][h3]Steam reviews: your thoughts matter[/h3][p]The best way to let me know what you think is if you leave me a review on steam. I will read all of them and they are an important resource for me to know what works and what has to be improved. Of course, they also help the game gain more visibility and traction![/p][p][/p][h3]Where to report bugs?[/h3][p]If you encounter any bugs or issues please report them either in the Steam Community forum or in the official [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FgnCBX6dPtd"]Discord[/url]. I will try to address any issues as fast as possible, but as I am a solo developer it might take me some time if it is a bigger issue.[/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you![/h3][p]Lastly I want to take this opportunity to thank everyone from the discord community who has supported me and provided valuable help and feedback. Without all of you Evolve Lab would not be what it is today :)[/p][h2][/h2][p][/p]

notes.title: Evolve Lab Releases into Early Access on August 29th!
notes.notes: [p]The wait is almost over! Evolve Lab will release into Early Access in a bit more than a week! I want to take this opportunity to share with you what you can expect from the Early Access release.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Planet[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39989439/ba0b6ed7b441b97295d07867e2657229bf04582a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39989439/07e7acc180e8fec4122fb94cb45f13745e49fa45.png"][/img][/p][p]Play on SEBOS IV, which adds 2 new creatures, 10 new actions, 4 new modules and 12 new cores. Bringing the total content of the initial Early Access release to:[/p][list][*][p]8 playable deep sea creatures[/p][/*][*][p]40 Actions for their state machine[/p][/*][*][p]15 Modules that can be added to those actions[/p][/*][*][p]12 Modifiers to change the stats of your creature or actions[/p][/*][*][p]48 Cores to give your creature that special something[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39989439/cf678107761f65d84643b99fe8ba9442b60c34e1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I am certain that this large amount of different options will result in a diverse and fun meta for all of you to shape and discover![/p][p][/p][h2]Private Galaxies[/h2][p]Private galaxies allow you to create a space were you only encounter creatures created by other players that have joined the same galaxy. This means you can now play on a planet with just your friends. Progress is shared between all galaxies so you can freely swap between them without having to unlock the same things twice.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Progression System[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39989439/ebf34d6f87a63010619f2ba896f548eba855001d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Build and upgrade research stations to track your progress in researching the depths of these strange planets. They come with a new reward type, used to unlock hats and skins for your creatures.[/p][p]Hats and skins are not in the game yet but will be added during early access but you can already start collecting the currency for unlocking them in the meantime. These will be purely cosmetic and a cool way to make your favorite creations stand out even more.[/p][p][/p][h2]Starting Loadouts[/h2][p]On later planets you can select a few items to take with you on a dive. This can help you better prepare for what type of build you are going for.[/p][p][/p][h3]Many small improvements[/h3][p]I have also taken all of your feedback from the Demo into account, which resulted in many bug fixes and balance changes.[/p][p][/p][h3]What will happen to the demo?[/h3][p]The demo will be online until the 27th of August. Afterwards I will take the servers and demo down to allow me to migrate all of your progress to the Early Access version. You will keep all your unlocked planets and creatures and the research and deep research points that you have earned during the demo.[/p][p][/p][p]I am looking forward to making Evolve Lab into its best version with all of your input during Early Access.[/p]

[h3]The demo features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 6 unique creatures to pick from
[*] 30 different actions
[*] 11 different modules and modifiers to further modify actions
[*] 30 different cores to make your creatures even more unique
[/list]

Demo progress will carry over to the full release.

I'm looking forward to your feedback and suggestions!

notes.title: Evolve Lab Demo Release Date and Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm thrilled to announce that the Evolve Lab Demo will officially launch this Friday,[b] May 30st at 20:00 CET! [/b]

This marks a big milestone, and I’m incredibly excited to share this with all of you who’ve supported the project so far. The demo will also be part of Steam Next Fest, which kicks off on June 9th. This gives me one more week to refine the demo and I'm counting on your feedback and suggestions to have a great version ready for everyone who will experience Evolve Lab for the first time during it.

If you’ve checked out the store page recently, you may have noticed the stunning new visuals! Huge thanks to RedPotionStudios for creating the gorgeous promotional art!

[h3]Whats changing with the demo release?[/h3]
[list]
[*]The closed alpha phase will end once the demo goes live. Alpha keys will no longer be valid.
[*]Progress will be fully reset when switching to the demo.
[*]From this point forward, demo progress will carry over to the full release!
[*]You can still expect planets to be reset occasionally to keep the meta fresh.
[/list]

[h3]Future Announcements:[/h3]
Moving forward, most official updates like patch notes and news will be posted here on Steam. On the Discord server, I will keep it more personal and try to interact with you guys as much as possible. My dream would be to create a close community of people that love playing this game. So feel free to join the community, if you haven't already: [url=https://discord.gg/gnCBX6dPtd]Discord server[/url].

[h3]Thank You[/h3]
To everyone who’s played the game, shared feedback, and been part of this journey so far, thank you! Your input has been a huge part of shaping what Evolve Lab has become and I can’t wait to see what you think of the demo and how the game evolves from here on.

notes.title: A new start with new art!
notes.notes:
As some of you have probably noticed, I took some time off working on Evolve Lab at the end of last year. This was mainly due to the workload of my computer science master but also because my wife did not have the capacity to do any more art for the game and therefore I had to make the difficult decision on how I should continue the art direction of the game.

In the end I decided that I would try to create all the art for the game by myself instead of looking for another artist that could mimic the art-style of my wife. This meant that I would have to recreate all the game assets from the ground up and that sadly none of the amazing assets that my wife had already created would stay in the game.

An upside to this doover is that I can use a much simpler art-style and therefore asset creation will be faster and I can create new actions and creatures at a faster pace. It is also easier for me to iterate on the art and make small adjustments according to your feedback.

Since I had to start recreating all the art from scratch I also decided to code the whole game again from the ground up and switch to the newest version of the Godot game engine which allows for better performance and has some nice new features that make development easier.

This means that some content and features from the previous alpha versions will be missing in the next one, but I’m doing my best to add everything back into the game!

If you want to be part of the community join the discord: [url=https://discord.gg/D4MNsk2bfx]https://discord.gg/D4MNsk2bfx[/url]
